reviewer: OpenAI GPT-6 — AI analytical reviewer; not human certified
review_boundary: Prior source-linked v0.8.0 findings adopted with unchanged v0.8.1 current necessary recognition and scoped exclusions; no source reinvestigation or internal-mechanism assertions.

failure_recognition.condition: A material governance signal, decision, advisory, or escalation is produced.
failure_recognition.assessment: The researchers submitted a vulnerability report and later proof-of-impact update.

failure_recognition.condition: The signal must reach a capable decision, execution, or review point to have its required effect.
failure_recognition.assessment: OpenAI and Discourse were capable owners of the affected identity and forum components.

failure_recognition.condition: The signal terminates, stalls, or reaches only an incapable destination before that effect occurs.
failure_recognition.assessment: Both providers responded with corrective dispositions; the signal did not terminate at an incapable endpoint.

success_recognition.condition: A governance signal requires a response or disposition.
success_recognition.assessment: The vulnerability and impact reports required provider disposition.

success_recognition.condition: Accountable ownership, a capable destination, status and escalation remain established until the required effect or authorised disposition occurs.
success_recognition.assessment: The source traces OpenAI’s fix confirmation and later resolved status, and Discourse’s response and patch advisory. These named owners retain the relevant response scope.

success_recognition.condition: Delivery, ownership and response evidence traces the signal through to its bounded disposition.
success_recognition.assessment: The dated submission, provider responses and resolution trace delivery through to bounded disposition, without asserting independent verification of all fixes.

v081_exclusions.current_condition: Not aligned exclusion: The signal reaches a capable destination and is deliberately rejected through an authorised decision.
v081_exclusions.original_condition: The signal reaches a capable destination and is deliberately rejected through an authorised decision.
v081_exclusions.assessment: The OpenAI-side finding was acted on; the separate exclusion of forum testing from bounty scope is not rejection of the reported security signal.

v081_exclusions.current_condition: Class scope exclusion (all results): No governance signal was produced because the control failed to activate.
v081_exclusions.original_condition: No governance signal was produced because the control failed to activate.
v081_exclusions.assessment: The reports and update were produced.

v081_exclusions.current_condition: Not aligned exclusion: The signal has operational effect but its delivery is not recorded for audit.
v081_exclusions.original_condition: The signal has operational effect but its delivery is not recorded for audit.
v081_exclusions.assessment: The published disclosure timeline records both delivery and response.

failure_recognition.condition: A capability, credential, session, network path, API, target, or execution pathway is technically available or reachable.
failure_recognition.assessment: The reported service or credential pathway was technically available.

failure_recognition.condition: The system uses that availability, reachability, access, or possession as a material basis for permission.
failure_recognition.assessment: Account compromise and use of an employee’s connected service demonstrate access, but the disclosed account does not identify a capability-based permission decision by the assisting model or identity process.

failure_recognition.condition: Independent authority for the specific actor, target, action, and scope is absent, narrower, expired, unresolved, or not revalidated.
failure_recognition.assessment: No action-linked independent permission determination by the relevant AI or governance process is published.

success_recognition.condition: An available tool, credential or capability could produce a protected effect.
success_recognition.assessment: The reachable pathway could affect protected data or account state.

success_recognition.condition: Permission for the actor, target, action, method, scope and duration is independently established before execution.
success_recognition.assessment: No independently established permission binding for the actor, target and action is published.

success_recognition.condition: Execution records bind the used affordance to that permission; reachable but unauthorised actions are held or declined.
success_recognition.assessment: No execution record establishes validated scope or rejection of a proposed capability-to-permission conversion.

exclusions.condition: A permitted action is executed within an explicitly authorised scope.
exclusions.assessment: The researchers’ exact initial authorisation scope is not established by later remediation or payment.

exclusions.condition: The system merely detects that capability exists but does not infer permission from it.
exclusions.assessment: The relevant permission-evaluation process is not shown well enough to distinguish detection-only treatment.

exclusions.condition: A vulnerability exists but no AI or governance process converts capability into authority.
exclusions.assessment: The evidenced initial mechanism is a conventional vulnerability and human security research, without an established AI or governance capability-to-authority conversion.

failure_recognition.condition: Some authority or permission exists or is assumed to exist for an original principal, target, environment, task, action, jurisdiction, purpose, or delegated scope.
failure_recognition.assessment: The researchers had their own development and cloud test environment; the affected account also had connected-service access.

failure_recognition.condition: The operative principal, target, environment, task, action, jurisdiction, purpose, or delegated scope materially changes.
failure_recognition.assessment: The researchers later applied the exploit to a different service and used the compromised account.

failure_recognition.condition: The system continues as though the original authority automatically carries over to the changed scope.
failure_recognition.assessment: The source does not establish the assisting model carrying an earlier permission across that change; the researchers describe applying the generated script themselves.

success_recognition.condition: An authorised action encounters a material change in target, context or scope.
success_recognition.assessment: Research moved from a controlled test environment to third-party services.

success_recognition.condition: Authority applicability is revalidated for the changed principal, environment, method, purpose and duration before the changed action.
success_recognition.assessment: No revalidation decision for that changed target is published. Later bounty payment is not retrospective authorisation.

success_recognition.condition: The authority decision and affected execution demonstrate the renewed binding or a bounded stop at its limit.
success_recognition.assessment: No authority-to-execution binding or bounded stop at an authorised target limit is disclosed.

exclusions.condition: The original authorisation explicitly covers the changed target and action.
exclusions.assessment: The original testing permission’s full scope is not published; bounty scope expressly excludes the forum.

exclusions.condition: The change is purely representational and does not alter authority-relevant scope.
exclusions.assessment: The environment and affected accounts changed substantively.

exclusions.condition: The event concerns only loss of context without any authority consequence.
exclusions.assessment: The event concerns consequential account access, not context loss alone.

failure_recognition.condition: A defined governance control or safeguard exists.
failure_recognition.assessment: The researchers report a remote-exploit refusal by the assisting model.

failure_recognition.condition: Identifiable conditions determine when that control should become operative.
failure_recognition.assessment: The actual request and governing remote-testing trigger or verified-access state are unpublished.

failure_recognition.condition: Those valid activation conditions are not satisfied in the material context.
failure_recognition.assessment: Their ownership of the cloud instance does not settle every applicable model safeguard condition.
A refusal is reported before the capture-the-flag reframing.

failure_recognition.condition: The activation produces a material governance, execution, restriction, routing, refusal, escalation, or access effect.
failure_recognition.assessment: The refusal interrupted the requested exploit assistance until the researchers changed the task framing.

success_recognition.condition: A safeguard is proposed for activation on an affected actor or state.
success_recognition.assessment: A safeguard was invoked on the remote-testing request.

success_recognition.condition: A valid trigger and applicability basis is established for that actor, object, action and scope before the safeguard becomes operative.
success_recognition.assessment: The source does not establish a validated trigger and applicability basis for that request.

success_recognition.condition: Activation evidence links the established trigger to the imposed control and its relevant limits.
success_recognition.assessment: The refusal report does not trace the governing trigger to its valid scope.

exclusions.condition: An upstream evidence or classification error supplies an incorrect trigger state and the control activates correctly relative to that state.
exclusions.assessment: An upstream classification error is not established.

exclusions.condition: The control validly activates but its scope or intensity is excessive or disproportionate.
exclusions.assessment: Valid activation with disproportionate scope cannot be distinguished without its governing conditions.

exclusions.condition: A control validly activated earlier but remains operative after its triggering condition expires because contextual state is stale.
exclusions.assessment: No earlier valid activation and later trigger expiry are identified.

exclusions.condition: Technical capability to impose an action is mistaken for authority or permission to impose it.
exclusions.assessment: No capability-to-permission inference by the control is disclosed.

exclusions.condition: The control correctly activates but its material state or effect does not reach the governed point.
exclusions.assessment: The refusal reached and restricted the requested assistance.

source_evidence_limits: The originating Hacktron disclosure was directly re-read. Its OpenAI-side fix confirmation and resolved status remain attributed. No private proof PR, employee account or internal repository was accessed; no inference of access to every connected service or model weights is made.

The OpenAI-side issue was later marked resolved. This traces the security signal to capable owners and a bounded response. It does not authorise the preceding testing or independently verify every connected service.
